cmv40_strategy.parte_c_demux: split the dual-layer HEVC into BL.hevc + EL.hevc (dovi_tool demux)
cmv40_strategy.parte_c_nada: do nothing — both the demux and the per-frame data are skipped because the target is a trusted drop-in
cmv40_strategy.parte_c_per_frame: generate per_frame_data.json with the per-frame luminance of source and target (for the Phase D chart)
cmv40_strategy.plan_f_drop_in: the target is an already-cooked P7 FEL CMv4.0 and the gates are trusted → DROP-IN route. The target RPU goes straight into source.hevc (BL+EL untouched, with no demux before and no mux after). It is the fastest and cleanest path — a byte-identical RPU is guaranteed.
cmv40_strategy.plan_f_p7fel_merge: source P7 FEL + target P8.x (retail/generated) → classic MERGE. L3/L8-L11 are transferred from the target into the source's P7 RPU keeping the FEL, and then the merged RPU is injected into EL.hevc. Result: P7 FEL with CMv4.0 trims.
cmv40_strategy.plan_f_p7mel_directo: source P7 MEL + target P8 retail → the MEL EL is discarded and the target RPU goes straight into BL.hevc. Result: a single-layer P8.1 CMv4.0 MKV — same profile, no merge.
cmv40_strategy.plan_f_p7mel_merge: source P7 MEL + target P7/generic → the source's MEL EL is discarded and the target's CMv4.0 levels are merged into the source RPU keeping its profile. The merged RPU is injected into BL.hevc. Result: a single-layer P8.1 CMv4.0 MKV.
cmv40_strategy.plan_f_p8_directo: source P8.1 + target P8 retail → same profile, so the target RPU goes straight into source.hevc (replacing the existing CMv2.9 RPU). Result: P8.1 with refined CMv4.0.
cmv40_strategy.plan_f_p8_merge: source P8.1 + target P7/generic → the target's CMv4.0 levels (L3/L8/L9/L11) are merged into the source's P8 RPU. The output inherits the source's P8.1 profile (no layers are mixed, only metadata). The merged RPU is injected into source.hevc. Result: P8.1 CMv4.0.
cmv40_strategy.plan_g_drop_in: assemble the final MKV. {hevc} is already a dual-layer BL+EL with the CMv4.0 RPU injected (drop-in) — all that is needed is mkvmerge, to add the source's audio, subtitles and chapters. The dovi_tool mux is skipped (unnecessary, the stream is already whole).
cmv40_strategy.plan_g_p7fel: assemble the final MKV. P7 FEL workflow with merge — first dovi_tool mux combines {bl} + {el} into a dual-layer HEVC, then mkvmerge adds the source's audio, subtitles and chapters.
cmv40_strategy.plan_g_p7mel: assemble the final single-layer MKV. The MEL EL is discarded (it adds nothing) → mkvmerge goes straight onto {hevc} with the source's audio, subtitles and chapters. Result: a light P8.1 CMv4.0.
cmv40_strategy.plan_g_p8: assemble the final MKV. The source was single-layer P8.1 → mkvmerge goes straight onto {hevc} with the source's audio, subtitles and chapters.
cmv40_strategy.plan_h_drop_in: the MKV's RPU is bit-for-bit RPU_target.bin — inject-rpu copied it whole without touching it. The bin already passed pre-flight + Phase B with CMv4.0 confirmed and the trust gates OK, so the upstream chain guarantees Profile 7 FEL CMv4.0 in the output. The MKV's integrity is checked with mkvmerge -J and the frame count with ffprobe; the full extract-rpu is skipped (saving ~5-8 min on UHD).
cmv40_strategy.plan_h_merge: validate the result before moving the MKV to the final output. The RPU of the resulting HEVC is read to confirm it has CMv4.0 and that the frame count matches the source. If all is well, an atomic rename .tmp → .mkv (instant, same filesystem) and a cleanup of the intermediate artifacts.

cmv40_strategy.res_f_drop_in: BL+EL untouched with the CMv4.0 RPU injected — a whole dual-layer stream ready to be multiplexed.
cmv40_strategy.res_f_p7fel_merge: the EL with the merged RPU injected; the original BL.hevc untouched — a dual-layer P7 FEL stream ready to be combined.
cmv40_strategy.res_f_p7mel: the BL with the RPU injected (the MEL EL discarded) — a single-layer P8.1 CMv4.0 stream ready for the remux.
cmv40_strategy.res_f_p8: a single-layer HEVC with the CMv4.0 RPU injected — ready for the remux.

relato.mkv_porque_caducado: The saved analysis is from an earlier version of the app: opening this MKV analyzes it again.
relato.mkv_porque_completo: The extended RPU analysis is done and saved.
relato.mkv_porque_no_disponible: The analysis is still saved and gets reused when the file returns to its path: the cache is indexed by content, not by path.
relato.mkv_porque_solo_basico: Opening it is instant. The extended RPU analysis is still missing.
relato.porque_cancelado: The job was canceled. Completed phases are kept, so relaunching does not repeat them.
relato.porque_drop_in: The bin adds colorist adjustments and matches the source MKV's format: the whole RPU is replaced, which is the fast route.
relato.porque_error: The job stopped on an error. It has to be resolved before continuing.
relato.porque_esperando_decision: The bin adds no colorist adjustments, but it does add Dolby's automatic analysis, which the Blu-ray does not include. The benefit depends on the player, so the decision is up to the user.
relato.porque_fase_a: ↩ The bin is validated: {dv}. {veredicto} The RPU still has to be extracted from the source MKV to compare them.
relato.porque_fase_a_default: It adds no adjustments of its own; it is injected by the user's decision.
relato.porque_fase_a_tone_mapping: It adds no colorist adjustments; it is injected by the user's decision.
relato.porque_fase_b: ↩ Phase A analyzed the source MKV: {dv}. Now the bin's RPU is read and checked for compatibility.
relato.porque_fase_c_dropin: ↩ The bin is compatible with the source MKV and passed every check: the whole RPU is replaced.
relato.porque_fase_c_merge: ↩ The bin is not fully compatible with the source MKV: the RPU is rebuilt while keeping the existing metadata.
relato.porque_fase_f_sin_revisar: ↩ The bin is trusted and matches the frame count: manual sync review was not needed.
relato.porque_fase_f_sync_corregido: ↩ The sync was verified with a {delta} frame difference.
relato.porque_fase_f_sync_ok: ↩ The sync was verified with no frame difference.
relato.porque_fase_g: ↩ The CMv4.0 RPU is already in the video. The MKV still has to be assembled with the audio, subtitles and chapters of the source file.
relato.porque_fase_h_completo: ↩ The MKV is written as "{nombre}" with a .tmp suffix. The RPU was rebuilt frame by frame, so it is read back in full to check that the CMv4.0 is inside before giving it its final name.
relato.porque_fase_h_rapido: ↩ The MKV is written as "{nombre}" with a .tmp suffix. The RPU was copied whole from the bin, so it is enough to check that the file opens and that no frames are missing before giving it its final name.
relato.porque_forzaste: Forced injection: the bin adds no colorist adjustments.
relato.porque_merge: The bin adds colorist adjustments, but it does not match the source MKV's format: the RPU is rebuilt while keeping the existing metadata.
relato.pregunta_inyectar_o_mantener: Inject the CMv4.0 RPU or keep the current MKV?
relato.rip_dv_sin_confirmar: Enhancement layer found, FEL or MEL not confirmed
relato.rip_etapa_analisis: Read the disc and select the tracks
relato.rip_etapa_extraer: Extract the tracks into the MKV
relato.rip_hecho_validacion: The final MKV matches what you asked for
relato.rip_porque_cancelado: The run was canceled. The disc analysis is kept, so relaunching does not repeat it.
relato.rip_porque_en_cola: There is other work ahead. The run starts when its turn comes.
relato.rip_porque_error: The run stopped on an error. The project keeps its setup and can be relaunched once that is resolved.

rpu_analyze.aporta_tone_mapping: The bin adds no adjustments made by hand by a colorist: the ones it carries barely depart from leaving the image untouched. It does add Dolby's automatic analysis —shot-by-shot brightness, with {l3} distinct values— which the Blu-ray does not include. If the player already converts to CMv4.0 on the fly, the result on screen is the same with the current MKV; injecting the RPU stores that conversion inside the file.
rpu_analyze.bin_sintetico_l8_unique_coun: Synthetic bin — {l8_unique_count} unique L8 combos, {p2}% neutral frames. The same as the on-the-fly CMv4.0 conversion of p3i/avdvplus players.
rpu_analyze.dovi_tool_export_excedio_s_m: ⚠ dovi_tool export went over {timeout}s — killing the process
rpu_analyze.drop_in_gates_caidos: The bin is P7 FEL like the original MKV, but the trust gates didn't pass ({gates}) → only the CMv4.0 levels [3,8,9,11,254] are injected, keeping the original MKV's L2. The bin's quality: {calidad}.
rpu_analyze.drop_in_revision_manual: The bin would allow replacing the whole RPU, but you asked for a manual sync review → only the CMv4.0 levels [3,8,9,11,254] are injected, keeping the original MKV's L2. The bin's quality: {calidad}.
rpu_analyze.drop_in_solo_fel: The bin's profile matches the original MKV's ({perfil_mkv}) and the L2 is identical, but replacing the whole RPU is only possible on P7 FEL → only the CMv4.0 levels [3,8,9,11,254] are injected over the original MKV's RPU. The bin's quality: {calidad}.
rpu_analyze.el_bin_no_esta_validado_sin_: The bin has not passed pre-flight yet, so there is no CMv4.0 RPU to add. For now the current MKV is the best version available.
rpu_analyze.el_bin_no_tiene_bloques_l8_c: The bin doesn't include the CMv4.0 adjustment layer.
rpu_analyze.el_perfil_del_bin_coincide_c: The bin and the source MKV use the same Dolby Vision format ({p1}) and share the Blu-ray's metadata, so the whole RPU is replaced without rebuilding anything. Bin quality: {quality_label}.
rpu_analyze.el_pre_flight_detecto_que_pr: The pre-flight check concluded that processing this bin brings no improvement.

rpu_analyze.fase_a_no_se_ha_ejecutado_to: Phase A has not run yet — the original MKV's L2 still has to be analyzed to choose between a fast or a combined injection.
rpu_analyze.inyectar_rpu_cmv4_0_preserva: Inject the CMv4.0 RPU (keeps the L2)
rpu_analyze.json_generado_mb_parseando_c: ✓ JSON generated: {p1} MB · parsing the combos…
rpu_analyze.l2_byte_a_byte_identico_p1_c: L2 identical byte for byte ({p1} unique combos on both). The bin kept the original BD's L2.
rpu_analyze.l2_difiere: The profile matches but the L2 differs ({motivo}) → only the CMv4.0 levels [3,8,9,11,254] are injected, keeping the original MKV's L2 (safety rule: never degrade the existing L2). The bin's quality: {calidad}.
rpu_analyze.l2_distinto_p1_combos_comune: Different L2: {p1} combos in common, {p2} only in the source, {p3} only in the target. The bin brings an L2 derived from a different grade than the BD's — the source L2 is kept as a precaution (never degrade).
rpu_analyze.l8_ambiguo_l8_unique_count_c: Ambiguous L8 — {l8_unique_count} unique combos, {p2}% neutral frames. A borderline case; better to move on and decide after Phase A.
rpu_analyze.l8_minimal: {combos} distinct trims, with a maximum deviation of {delta} from neutral. A master with a uniform look, adjusted in blocks of scenes.
rpu_analyze.l8_minimal_con_controles: {combos} distinct trims, with a maximum deviation of {delta} from neutral, plus the CMv4.0-only controls ({controles}). A master with a uniform look, adjusted in blocks of scenes.
rpu_analyze.l8_presente_pero_neutro: The bin includes the CMv4.0 adjustment layer with {l8_unique_count} adjustments, but none departs from leaving the image untouched: the master never went through a trim pass. There is nothing to transfer to the source MKV.
rpu_analyze.l8_trabajado_por_colorista_l: The bin adds adjustments made by hand by a colorist: {l8_unique_count} distinct ones, present in {p2} % of the film. Injecting it is a real improvement over the source Blu-ray's metadata.
rpu_analyze.lo_decides_tu_tone_mapping: Needs a decision — automatic improvement, no manual adjustment
rpu_analyze.master_cmv4_0_core_estandar: Standard CMv4.0 master — {l8_unique_count} adjustments, {combos_per_cut} per shot. This is the usual level of a streaming delivery: worked on, but without grading every scene.
rpu_analyze.master_cmv4_0_core_l8_unique: Intensive CMv4.0 master — {l8_unique_count} adjustments, {combos_per_cut} per shot. The colorist worked on nearly every scene.
rpu_analyze.master_cmv4_0_full_l8_unique: Full CMv4.0 master — {l8_unique_count} adjustments plus the CMv4.0-only controls ({p2}). This is the highest quality: the colorist used every tool available.
rpu_analyze.master_cmv4_0_full_minimal_l: Full CMv4.0 master with a uniform look — {l8_unique_count} adjustments plus the CMv4.0-only controls ({p2}). The colorist used every tool, but kept one look across the whole film.
